Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You emphasise copper’s rise while offering a fixed price; it sounds like recovering input costs with commercial certainty matters to you. We want an adjustment that recognises justified cost pressure and supports our long-term partnership. How can we bring the verified cost trends and our growing demand into a balanced agreement?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10). Our demand forecast for Motor IE3 7.5 kW is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 364.69 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We have reviewed your proposal and verified the referenced volume increase and steel index development, which are now reflected in our calculation. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot is a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. An extension of the payment terms to 90 days is not feasible for us; we must therefore maintain our standard 30 days net. Based on these verified data points and our standard payment terms, we are prepared to offer a revised price of €368.42 per unit. Alternatively, at our standard terms, a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net: €368.42 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG team,

You repeatedly return to payment timing and ask for a firm volume commitment—it sounds like predictable cash flow and demand matter alongside recovering your cost increases. We want a sustainable agreement that respects those concerns and preserves our long-standing partnership. How can we address your payment-timing constraint while translating the value of our binding commitment into a mutually workable price?

We confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months. Copper notation for cables and motors (derived) changed -2.2% from 2026-01 to 2026-03 (idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-01, idx:CU-NOTATION@2026-03).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 365.31 per unit, 90 days payment, no index clause). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have verified the recent minor decrease in the copper notation, which is now reflected in our calculation. However, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.

Our current offer is a price of €371.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

To provide a more workable price while addressing our payment-timing constraints, we must maintain our standard 30 days net payment terms. Alternatively, at our standard terms, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel: a price of €367.43 per unit.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
